bead.title: bench-pr-A4: concurrency (flock/setsid/job-pool, in-flight state) + signal handling (SIGINT/SIGTERM)
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The bash runner must run cells concurrently with per-group locking and a bounded job pool, track in-flight cells across hosts, and shut down cleanly on signals — stopping harbor-runner containers and marking interrupted cells. Without this the runner cannot match the Go runner's parallelism or interrupt safety.

ROOT CAUSE:
- cmd/bench/matrix.go (~2232 LOC) owns the concurrency-group locking, process-group management, and interrupt handling being ported to bash.

PROPOSED FIX:
- Concurrency: flock per concurrency-group at ${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR:-${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/fizeau-benchmark}/locks/<group>.lock; setsid for each cell process group; background-job pool capped by --jobs.
- Concurrent-cells state: ${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}/<hostname>/in-flight.json. Under flock, append this cell at start, read current count into the cell, remove at close; prune stale (dead-PID) entries at next read.
- Signals: trap SIGINT/SIGTERM. Stop accepting new cells; SIGTERM each in-flight cell's process group and `docker stop` each in-flight harbor-runner container; wait 30s then SIGKILL; write final_status=interrupted (process_outcome=killed, no metrics) to in-flight cells; exit non-zero.

NON-SCOPE: arg parsing / matrix / --plan (A2); execution loop / report / budget / retry (A3); adapters + image (A1); Go agent-leak fix, Go deactivation, parity (A5). Parent out-of-scope preserved: PR B schema; PR C bench-set schema; PR D collector; PR E importers; PR F deleting cmd/bench; PR G docs. Governing artifact plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

DEPENDS ON: A3 (and transitively A2, A1).

ACCEPTANCE (satisfies parent AC5):
1. SIGTERM to a mid-sweep ./benchmark marks in-flight cells final_status=interrupted, `docker stop`s their harbor-runner containers, and the runner exits non-zero. Verify: ./benchmark --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary & sleep 5; kill -TERM $!; wait; jq .final_status bench/results/.../report.json. TestSigtermMarksInterruptedStopsContainers. (parent AC5)
2. Per-group flock serializes cells in the same concurrency-group while distinct groups run in parallel up to --jobs. TestConcurrencyGroupLockAndJobPool.
3. in-flight.json gains an entry at cell start, records the live count, and is pruned of dead-PID entries on the next read. TestInFlightStatePruning.
GATES: bats scripts/benchmark/test passes; `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance: Parent AC5 holds; acceptance 1-3 pass; bats, go test ./..., and lefthook run pre-commit all green.
